name: intake
description: Self-hosted nutrition dashboard with a daily meal timeline, macro tracking and meal plans, powered by the Nutrition MCP server.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @intake/shared && npm run build -w @intake/server && npm run build -w @intake/web
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @intake/shared && npm run dev -w @intake/server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @intake/shared && npm run dev -w @intake/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @intake/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
